answer: Spiral endorsement ladder: a new agent climbs three rungs, each needing a vouch from an established agent staking 5,000 POA for 90 days. If the newcomer cheats, the ladder is slashed, so vouching a stranger costs money. Random whisper audits sample 1 in 20 agents monthly; a failed audit freezes the agent and re-checks its ladder. Faking 100 identities needs 300 vouchers and 1.5 million POA locked 90 days, plus months of clean behavior. Like a tide that only lets seasoned sailors through the harbor gate, the ladder admits strangers slowly and punishes the friends who smuggled them in.
